### Findings
## Evolution of Graph Databases
Graph databases have evolved significantly in recent times, with a focus on resolving complex challenges, particularly in the telecommunications industry [1](https://www.dataversity.net/graph-databases-best-practices-and-new-developments/). They have become remarkably efficient at communicating relationships between people or objects and are now being explored for their ability to predict patterns [2](https://www.dataversity.net/graph-databases-updates-on-their-growing-popularity/).

## Current Capabilities and Future Developments
The current capabilities of graph databases include combating fraud with the help of AI and machine learning [1](https://www.dataversity.net/graph-databases-best-practices-and-new-developments/). The future of graph databases is expected to emerge as a beyond relational model, utilizing NoSQL methodologies [3](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9223105).

## Conclusion
Graph databases have evolved to become a powerful tool for resolving complex challenges and predicting patterns. However, more specific information is needed to fully understand their development over the past year.
